supported_fields.mechanics: Multi-hitting beam; a second input while the initial blast is connecting consumes another 100 Ki to prolong the beam and deal additional damage.
supported_fields.character_source: SSGSS Goku; Goku; Goku (Super Saiyan God); Goku (GT); Goku (Super Saiyan 4)
